lessons_used: Predictions were generally overoptimistic for large changes, though winning tests were often underpredicted.
Reordering sign-in (sign_in, reorder) consistently worked and proved helpful across 2 tests.
Adding a new finish screen (finish, new_screen) hurt performance or showed no clear effect across 2 tests.
Sign-in copy tweaks (sign_in, copy) and new adoption flows (adoption, new_flow) showed no clear effect across 2 tests each.
Evidence remains thin for all other change types (hints, incentives, redesigns, layout changes, and home wait info) due to single tests or mixed results.

candidates.title: Move sign-in after custom photo upload
candidates.change: Move the sign-in screen to take place after photo upload and pet selection but before the adoption certificate screen.
candidates.why: Reordering sign-in later in the funnel has consistently shown strong performance in prior tests, allowing users to pick or create their pet first.

guard.reason: Reordering sign-in after photo upload is explicitly permitted by Rule 4.

candidates.score_note: Reordering sign-in later in the flow has a proven track record (+3.1% avg) across previous tests.

candidates.title: Pick friend screen carousel redesign
candidates.change: Redesign the pet selection screen to use a carousel layout featuring dynamic preview components for each pet option.
candidates.why: Adoption has a relatively low conversion rate (60.9%) and long completion times (median 89s / mean 1017s); a carousel layout makes pet browsing smoother.

guard.reason: Redesigning pet selection as a carousel preserves the job of letting the user choose a pet.

candidates.score_note: Adoption has high drop-off (39.1%), but redesign evidence remains thin.

candidates.title: Interactive photo upload checklist flow
candidates.change: Convert photo upload into a guided checklist sub-flow with mascot instructions for custom pet creation.
candidates.why: Support emails highlight issues where custom pets fail or look wrong (3 emails), and adoption drop-off is high.

components.text: Follow these simple steps for the best pet creation result!

guard.reason: Converting photo upload to a checklist sub-flow is an allowed onboarding enhancement.

candidates.score_note: Strong evidence from both funnel drop-off and support mail, but adoption new flows previously showed minimal impact (+0.7%).

candidates.title: Pre-waiting pet setup verification screen
candidates.change: Add a new confirmation screen before the waiting screen to display summary details of the adopted pet.
candidates.why: Adoption drop-off is 60.9% and users express confusion over pet creation output; a summary verification screen reassures users before processing.

new_pet_summary.headline: Your Pet is Ready to Hatch!
new_pet_summary.body: Review your pet details before entering your desktop habitat.

guard.reason: Adding a new pet summary verification screen inside onboarding is permitted under Rule 4.

candidates.score_note: Adding new verification screens historically degrades performance (-4.5%).

candidates.title: Waiting screen ready notification toggle
candidates.change: Enable a system notification toggle on the waiting screen so users get alerted when pet generation completes.
candidates.why: The home waiting step has a long mean duration (2336s) and 15.6% drop-off; notification options let users multitask without abandoning.

waiting.hint: We will notify you on your desktop as soon as your pet is ready!

guard.reason: Adding notification settings and hints to the waiting screen is permitted by Rule 4.

candidates.score_note: Home wait info changes have consistently yielded positive lift (+2.6%).

candidates.title: Story screen spotlight layout redesign
candidates.change: Update the story screen to a spotlight layout featuring a prominent animated pet hero element.
candidates.why: Choose_path has a high mean duration (514s); an engaging spotlight intro screen improves initial user momentum.

guard.reason: Redesigning the story screen layout retains its job of introducing the pet.

candidates.score_note: Layout adjustments on choose_path showed initial positive results (+2.5%), but evidence is based on 1 test.

candidates.title: Adoption certificate official badge
candidates.change: Add a highlighted founder companion badge component to the adoption certificate screen.
candidates.why: Adoption has a 60.9% conversion rate; adding a reward component increases completion motivation.

guard.reason: Replacing the adoption certificate stamp with a founder badge fails to present an official adoption stamp.

candidates.title: Home intro desktop controls tray hint
candidates.change: Add text and hint components on the final home intro screen explaining desktop tray access and pet interaction shortcuts.
candidates.why: 3 support tickets reported confusion about how to control, hide, or talk to the pet after onboarding, and 3 reported pet visibility issues.

home_intro.hint: Access your desktop system tray anytime to control or chat with your pet.

components.text: Tip: Right-click your desktop pet for quick settings and actions.

guard.reason: Adding desktop tray hints to the home intro screen is allowed inside onboarding.

candidates.score_note: High support ticket overlap, but finish step hints performed poorly in past testing (-1.5%).

candidates.title: Waiting screen animated companion idle preview
candidates.change: Add an animated hatching pet preview component to the waiting screen while background generation finishes.
candidates.why: Waiting screen median time is 201s and mean time is 2336s; visual engagement prevents drop-off during generation.

guard.reason: Adding an animated preview component to the waiting screen is an allowed modification.

candidates.score_note: Addresses high waiting duration with proven wait_info pattern (+2.6%), though implementation cost is higher.

candidates.title: Choose path screen headline copy refresh
candidates.change: Rewrite the choose_path screen headline and body to clearly distinguish preset adoption from custom photo creation.
candidates.why: Choose_path mean time is 514s, indicating hesitation when choosing between preset and photo custom paths.

choose_path.headline: Choose Your Companion Path
choose_path.body: Select a ready-made desktop pet or create a custom pet from your photos.

guard.reason: Updating choose_path copy to clarify adoption vs custom creation retains the screen's core job.

candidates.score_note: Low cost copy tweak addressing hesitation, though copy changes usually have subtle effects.

decisions.title: Move sign-in after custom photo upload
Choose path screen headline copy refresh
Home intro desktop controls tray hint

lessons_next: Predictions were generally overly optimistic, especially for major changes, redesigns, and new screens.
Reordering sign-in (sign_in, reorder) was helpful in 2 winning tests, though one specific placement hurt.
Adding a new finish screen (finish, new_screen) hurt performance or showed no clear effect across 2 tests.
Sign-in copy tweaks (sign_in, copy), new adoption flows (adoption, new_flow), and finish hints (finish, hint) showed no clear effect across 2 tests each.
Home wait info changes (home, wait_info) yielded mixed results across 3 tests, with only 1 win.
Evidence remains thin for all other change kinds (redesigns, incentives, layouts, home hints) due to single tests.
